body.p: How the tundra people accepted a new person in the tent. In ancient times, a person, providing for his life, prayed to his gods: âMy God, why does heaven do this: it only sends me daughters. No matter how I pray to God, I do not get a son. In the tundra, we really need a person with skilful hands. A young man would look well before marriage: if the girl knows how to sew or does not know how. Enets people like such women: her body should be strong, she should be calm, she should have a good mind. He looks for such a woman who would have many children. A new man will come to the tent â he will come in the dark month, in ten days. My daughter, my Wotane will get married. I have chosen Casali as my son-in-law. With this speech, we brought in a new chief for our reindeer. Dear, you will be the master of our life, the gatherer of our life. Now you have your own fishing and hunting tools: nets, lasso, gun. Take a good care of it â these are the necessary things. You will have children â they need to be fed, God sees you. In any difficult moments, ask us old people. You will feed us, after all. Keep your family well. Live well. Let your paths be successful, live a happy life. That is how in the old days the tundra people took a new person to a tent, so they instructed him.
